transcript.text: Hi everyone. I see we have a draft rollout plan for the authentication-library patch — Thursday 02:00 UTC canary for 60 minutes, then broad deployment on Friday. Before I can approve anything, our release policy requires a final round-robin check with application platform, reliability, and compliance. I need to hear from each of those areas and record any required rollout changes they have. Once all three have weighed in and their changes are incorporated into the plan, I'll make the final call. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: While debugging an unrelated authentication test this morning, I confirmed that the Ledger service uses a custom fork of the library. Ledger must have the compatibility flag enabled before broad deployment, and it must be excluded from the canary until that flag is enabled. I haven't updated the rollout document yet because the compatibility test completed only minutes ago.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a reliability concern with the proposed Thursday 02:00 UTC canary. While preparing another maintenance window, I checked the current on-call rota and confirmed that I am the only engineer qualified to perform rollback for this patch during Wednesday 18:00-22:00 UTC. The Thursday 02:00 UTC slot has no qualified rollback engineer on the rota. Therefore, the Thursday canary cannot be approved as proposed — the canary must move to Wednesday 18:00 UTC to have confirmed rollback coverage. I haven't posted the staffing confirmation yet because the rota change is still being recorded, but this is a required rollout change from the reliability area.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a required rollout change from the compliance area. I confirmed with the audit team this afternoon that evidence showing every internet-facing service patched is due by Friday 12:00 UTC, and an exception would not satisfy this review. The audit team's written confirmation arrived minutes ago, so I haven't yet added it to the security ticket, but this is a binding requirement: the rollout plan must ensure all internet-facing services are patched with evidence collected by Friday 12:00 UTC.
